mutants.description: Treat observed masks as errors without undoing randomized targets.
Divide every forward transform by the state count.
Fit against row positions instead of manifest sequence lengths.
Force every nuisance amplitude to one.
Replace the recovered joint law by the product of its one-bit marginals.
Multiply clique marginals without separator division.
Report unconditional mutual information as all-rest conditional mutual information.
Sort nonlocal pairs by increasing rather than decreasing conditional mutual information.
Report unsquared Jensen-Shannon divergence instead of its square-root distance.
Ignore count probabilities and emit a uniform analysis with current shapes.
Reverse unit labels only in dependence analysis.
Ignore the supplied clique tree and assume every hidden topology is a sliding width-three chain.
